SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT KEY_1 AS LEGACY_PO_NO FROM PO_KEPTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'PODOWN' AND KEY_10 in (' ','T') GROUP BY KEY_1
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'FASH' AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, ISNULL(STATUS,'D') AS STATUS, KEY_1 AS LEGACY_PO_NO, KEY_2 AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, ISNULL(BUYER_ITEM_NO,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, 'KRW' AS CURRENCY_CODE, ISNULL(UNIT_PRICE,0) AS UNIT_PRICE, ISNULL(ITEM_QTY,0) AS ITEM_QTY, ISNULL(ITEM_AMT,0) AS ITEM_AMT, ISNULL(ADD_DATE,' ') AS ADD_DATE, ISNULL(RD_DATE,' ') AS RD_DATE, ISNULL(DELY_TO_LOCATION,' ') AS DELY_TO_LOCATION, ISNULL(PURCHASER_USER_ID,' ') AS PURCHASER_USER_ID, ISNULL(KEY_3,' ') AS LEGACY_PR_NO, ISNULL(REQ_USER_NAME,' ') AS REQ_USER_NAME, ISNULL(REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME,' ') AS REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME, ISNULL(PRE_GR_FLAG,' ') AS PRE_GR_FLAG, ISNULL(REMARK1,' ') AS REMARK, ISNULL(REMARK2,' ') AS REMARK2, ISNULL(REF_IF_NO,' ') AS REF_IF_NO FROM PO_KEP_PODETAIL_V , PO_KEPTRXL WHERE KEY_1 *= LEGACY_PO_NO AND KEY_2 *= LEGACY_PO_SEQ AND KEY_3 *= ISNULL(LEGACY_PR_NO,' ') AND KEY_10 in (' ','T') AND DOC_NAME = 'PODOWN' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' ORDER BY KEY_1,KEY_2
UPDATE PO_KEPTRXL SET KEY_10 = 'D', KEY_9 = GETDATE() WHERE KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND DOC_NAME = 'PODOWN' AND KEY_10 in (' ','T')
